Over the past few years, many of us who have settled in Kitchener have embarked on a journey
of learning, understanding and reconciliation with the Indigenous people we share these
lands with today.
This evening, we're here in the heart of downtown Kitchener.
The City of Kitchener and all of Waterloo Region is situated on the traditional territory of
the neutral Anishinaabe and Haudenosaunee peoples.
We recognize our shared responsibility to serve as stewards for the land and honor the
original caretakers who came before us.
Our community is enriched by the enduring knowledge and deep-rooted traditions of the
diverse First Nations, Métis and Inuit in Kitchener today.

the strong women and men who we now walk with on Turtle Island.

the group of people I have come to know and respect has grown.

Michael is regarded as the angelic protector of Ukraine's capital cave and by extension,

It is a church monastery which has an important historical role and message for us today.
